opportunities.title: Small Grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel awards up to £2,000-£2,500 per person; PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support. Grant payments cannot be made to personal bank accounts. Previous recipients may apply for new projects.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that might otherwise not be possible, bringing people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 per year; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration is also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference given to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applicants particularly welcomed. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan and be supported by reputable referees not based at the same institution as either partner.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
